evidence.title: Reelfolio — Create Portfolio Showreels in Minutes

name: Reelfolio
summary: Turns screenshots, mockups and clips into animated portfolio showreel videos from 245+ motion templates.
description: Web app that renders design work in motion: upload screenshots (PNG, JPG, WebP), Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD/Penpot mockups or short clips, pick a motion template, set colors, timing, background and aspect ratio, and export a 1080p or 4K MP4 in under a minute. Showreel templates tell a story from start to finish; loop templates run seamlessly. A Render API renders videos programmatically from scripts or agents.
contains: 245 motion templates: showreels and seamless loops
input: PNG/JPG/WebP screenshots, Figma/Sketch/XD/Penpot mockups, short clips
Render API: POST /api/v1/render on paid plans, scale 480p to 4K
free tools: section screenshot, image highlighter, image splitter
pricing: $12 a month or $108 a year
built on Remotion, cloud rendering on AWS Lambda
